## EHRLICHIA CHAFFEENSIS (HUMAN MONOCYTOTROPIC EHRLICHIOSIS)
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Treat for at least 5 to 7 days, up to 10 days may be required for more severe or
complicated cases
## Treatment
## Inpatient [Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Doxycycline 100 mg IV q12h ($$) [DI]](psjizid-doxycycline-100mg-iv-q12h)
## Outpatient [Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) [DI]](psozid2-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid-5ds)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid-5ds)
< OR >
Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for IV options
References:
Mandell chapter: Rickettsioses, Ehrlichioses, and Anaplasmosis
MMWR RR. 2016, 65 (2) 1-44
Sanford keyword: Ehrlichiosis: Human monocytic ehrlichiosis (HME)
Up-to-Date article: Human ehrlichiosis and anaplasmosis
